page.text:
Writing this at the end. I feel like a lot of the comments might feel a little harsh, but it's just the things that I really needed to put my thoughts forward. The amount of elements that I did not leave comment on means that there's a ton that I agree with. And in general, I do think between the two runs we made some valuable changes in the way we critique things. I like we are a little bit more detailed, I like we're looking a little bit more on photographic concepts without leaving notes about what's in the photo, just a little bit more from the perspective of photography.

Worries about overcorrecting only in that direction though remain, so let's see what we can improve even further on.But overall, really nice job on this comparison and on iterative taste corrections.
